note: Adapted from Bacchus's (1997) redescription of the species (in English); the alate, soldier and major worker all have prose descriptions and measurement tables. The original description is Sjöstedt 1907 (Termes (Microtermes) vadschaggae). The author groups the alate with those of mariae, magnocellus, alluaudanus and albopartitus. In the OCR of the alate measurement table the pronotum width row reads '1.08—0.13' and the hind tibia '1.13=1.25', read here from their proportions as 1.08—1.13 and 1.13—1.25.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule orange-yellow to orange-brown, the cheeks paler, the head surface with many pale yellow dots of various sizes scattered at the hair bases; anteclypeus and labrum yellow-white; antennae pale yellow, segments 1 and 2 darker; postclypeus yellow; pronotum yellow to yellowish brown, slightly paler than the head, with a pale cross-shaped marking; abdominal tergites pale yellow and brown, the sternites slightly paler; legs evenly yellow. Wings pale yellow, the costa darker. Posterior margin of the head capsule arcuate and evenly rounded; the vertex not depressed in the region of the frontal gland pore; frons smooth, sloping towards the postclypeus; short and long hairs above and behind the compound eyes, the long hairs almost reaching the outer margin of the compound eyes; frontal gland pore a very small opening, smaller than the ocellus; median spot small and nearly circular; the trunk part of the cranial suture visible. Compound eyes almost circular; ocelli short and nearly circular, far from the compound eyes; postclypeal median suture moderately distinct; labrum shorter than wide; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly smaller than segment 4, segments 1 and 2 about equal. Pronotum hairy, denser along the lateral margins, the sutures indistinct, the anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Meso- and metanota without a median longitudinal line, the posterior margin moderately incurved. Wings extending beyond the abdomen.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to dull yellow; mandibles brown to yellowish brown with a yellow base; antennae, body and legs pale yellow. Head capsule short-oval to long-oval, the sides converging forwards from behind the antennal fossae. Labrum tongue-shaped, extending almost to the tip of the mandibles, widest in the middle and narrowing to a pointed tip; 3—4 pairs of hairs in the anterior third. Mandibles moderately stout, the tip incurved, the degree of curvature 0.04—0.05 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segments 1 and 2 about equal, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 distinctly larger. Pronotum narrower than the head capsule, the anterior lobes small and separated by a moderately deep V-shaped median notch, the posterior lobe large and semicircular with the middle of the margin slightly incurved. Fore tibia very swollen.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule yellow to dull yellow; mandibles brown with a yellow base; antennae, pronotum, legs, abdominal tergites and sternites pale yellow; postclypeal pad dark brown. Head capsule almost rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broad and evenly rounded; head hairs numerous, regularly and symmetrically arranged; the fork of the cranial suture present; postmentum with several hairs. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 slightly larger, segments 1 and 2 about equal. Postclypeus inflated, very lenticular, the median suture distinct, the posterior margin evenly rounded; anteclypeus flat, projecting forwards in the middle. Labrum broadly rounded; the transverse sclerotized band incomplete. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobes small, the anterior and posterior margins shallowly concave; fore tibia not swollen; the dorsal spur about as long as the outer ventral spur; fore coxa conical, the large hair on its front not spine-like.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (3 specimens, 3 colonies, mm): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.08—1.10, head width including the compound eyes 1.20—1.26, postclypeus length 0.30—0.33 and width 0.58, labrum length 0.34—0.40 and width 0.45—0.48, greatest compound eye diameter 0.33—0.35 and least diameter 0.31, greatest ocellus diameter 0.13—0.15 and least diameter 0.09—0.11, ocellus-to-compound-eye distance 0.05, pronotum length 0.70—0.75 and width 1.08—1.13, hind tibia length 1.13—1.25. Soldier measurements (16 specimens, 16 colonies): head including the mandibles 1.25—1.38, head length to the base of the mandibles 0.80—0.88, head width behind the antennal fossae 0.63—0.73, greatest head width 0.70—0.78, labrum length 0.28—0.33 and width 0.19—0.23, left mandible transverse length 0.48—0.53, width 0.05—0.06, curvature 0.04—0.05, fore tibia length 0.48—0.53 and width 0.14—0.15, hind tibia length 0.55—0.60 and width 0.10—0.11, greatest pronotum width 0.44—0.53, postmentum length 0.40—0.45, greatest width 0.30—0.33. Paratype soldiers and alates (Tanzania, AMNH).
